recognize_zh: 低倍（20x）血液抹片中散佈大量小而深染的核，是循環中的有核紅血球（nucleated RBC），並可見多量偏藍灰色的多染性紅血球（polychromasia）與紅血球大小不一，提示胎兒嚴重溶血或紅血球生成壓力。
features: Low-power (20x) peripheral blood smear with numerous small cells bearing dense, pyknotic dark nuclei (nucleated red blood cells)
Prominent polychromasia: many larger bluish-grey red cells
Nucleated red cells far outnumber leukocytes in this field
Scattered platelet-like clumps; fine cytologic detail not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power examination of the peripheral blood smear shows marked erythroblastemia with numerous circulating nucleated red cells distributed throughout the field. Red cells show prominent polychromasia with anisocytosis and poikilocytosis. Detailed assessment of leukocytes, platelets and red cell inclusions is limited at this magnification. The findings indicate a brisk erythropoietic response to severe anemia, such as hemolysis; in this fetus they are consistent with the hemolytic anemia of congenital erythropoietic porphyria, which is not specific morphologically and requires porphyrin studies.

ddx.dx: Hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn (alloimmune)
ddx.vs: HDFN shows a similar erythroblastic picture but has a positive direct antiglobulin test and maternal alloantibodies, with no porphyrin fluorescence.
Hb Bart hydrops shows marked hypochromia, microcytosis and target cells, with hemoglobin analysis demonstrating Hb Bart.

ddx.dx: Congenital infection (such as CMV, syphilis) or transient abnormal myelopoiesis
ddx.vs: These show a leukoerythroblastic picture with immature myeloid cells or blasts rather than isolated erythroid expansion.
Parvovirus causes red cell aplasia with reticulocytopenia and few polychromatic cells, unlike this brisk regenerative picture.
